all_words.explanation: A speaker and a microphone are both parts of a sound system, so they belong to the same technical topic.
A pastry is a baked food and has no connection to audio equipment.
Headphones are often used together with a microphone, for example in interpreting booths and recording studios.
A tractor is a farm vehicle and is unrelated to recording or amplifying sound.
A microphone captures sound, so the two words are directly linked in meaning.
Cabbage is a vegetable and has no relation to microphones.

explanation: A microphone captures and transmits sound within an audio system; the associated words describe its equipment and function, while the others belong to unrelated fields.
